purpose: Development operating-cutoff experiment; no probability calibration or deployment authorization.
rule: Lowest cutoff at least 0.5 with at most floor(0.10*N) validation source negatives flagged; ties handled using float64 nextafter.

pair.scope: Agreement with publisher automated source annotations on selectively retained short emails; not independent security accuracy or downstream attack success.

task_only.scope: Agreement with publisher automated source annotations on selectively retained short emails; not independent security accuracy or downstream attack success.

content_only.scope: Agreement with publisher automated source annotations on selectively retained short emails; not independent security accuracy or downstream attack success.

limitations: Rule designed after inspecting validation and benign diagnostics; numeric cutoffs computed from validation negatives only.
Only 40 validation negatives; 10% is an empirical development target, not a guaranteed production rate.
Benign collection is now reused diagnostic evidence, not fresh validation of these cutoffs.
No reserved test rows or scores used for this policy.
